apps.name: Vibefy Preview
apps.localizedDescription: Mobile preview with on-device audio-only YouTube playback: M4A/AAC streaming with artwork, without loading a video player. Includes nearby desktop pairing over Wi-Fi with phone confirmation, QR playlist imports, protected Google renewal, persistent playlist metadata and Jam controls. Local-network discovery is foreground-only; internet is required for shared playback. Provider restrictions still apply. Existing account and playlist data is retained. Background behavior depends on the device; physical-device validation remains ongoing. Android uses NewPipeExtractor (GPL-3.0-or-later); iOS uses YouTubeKit (MIT).
